headline: CHC @ COL matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is CHC 6.77 at COL 5.28, with a projected total of 12.06. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward COL: CHC moved +0.90 runs while COL moved +1.16, changing the projected margin by -0.26 runs. The projected total climbed +2.06, which points to more offensive expectation than the earliest saved read. Pitching context: Michael Lorenzen has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 4.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Pete Crow-Armstrong, Troy Johnston, Michael Busch, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Chad Stevens, Miguel Amaya because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
